t: Hiking In Oregon: A Complete Guide For First Timers
s: September 12, 2025 - A Northwest Forest Pass covers all of the trailheads on national forest land in both Oregon and Washington State, and is essentially a must-have for hikers in either state because the vast majority of hikes are on federal land. However, the America the Beautiful Pass (colloquially, the “national parks pass”) covers all federal land in the country, including national forests. Basically, if you’re planning to visit more than two national parks in the next 12 months, buy an America the Beautiful Pass (you can get it online at REI).
